definitions.explanation: A facility where aquatic animals and plants are kept and displayed for public viewing and education.

examples.japanese: {水族館|すいぞくかん}に{行|い}く。
{水族館|すいぞくかん}でイルカショーを{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched a dolphin show at the aquarium.

examples.japanese: この{水族館|すいぞくかん}は{日本|にほん}で{最|もっと}も{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: This aquarium is the largest in Japan.

notes:
{水族館|すいぞくかん} is a public facility displaying aquatic life.

WORD COMPOSITION:
- {水|すい}: water
- {族|ぞく}: tribe, group, species
- {館|かん}: building, hall

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水族館|すいぞくかん}に{行|い}く: to go to the aquarium
- {水族館|すいぞくかん}で{見|み}る: to see at the aquarium
- {水族館|すいぞくかん}の{入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}: aquarium admission fee

FAMOUS AQUARIUMS IN JAPAN:
- {沖縄|おきなわ}{美|ちゅ}ら{海|うみ}{水族館|すいぞくかん} (Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium)
- {海遊館|かいゆうかん} (Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan)
- すみだ{水族館|すいぞくかん} (Sumida Aquarium)
